articles.summary: - Conference Call and Webcast to be Held on Wednesday, October 28, 2026 - Hope Bancorp, Inc. (“the Company”) (NASDAQ: HOPE) today announced that the Company will report financial results for its third quarter and nine months ended September 30, 2026, before the markets open on Wednesday, October 28, 2026. A conference call to discuss financial results for the third quarter and nine months ended September 30, 2026, will be held on Wednesday, October 28, 2026, at 9:30 a.m. Pacific Time / 12:30 p.m. Eastern Time. A presentation deck to accompany the earnings call will be available on Hope Bancorp’s investor relations website located at www.ir-hopebancorp.com . articles.title: Hope Bancorp to Report Financial Results for the Third Quarter and Nine Months Ended September 30, 2026, on Wednesday, October 28, 2026

articles.summary: Hope Bancorp, Inc. (NASDAQ: HOPE) today announced that its wholly-owned subsidiary, Bank of Hope (“the Bank”), has completed its previously announced acquisition of the Commercial Banking Unit of SMBC MANUBANK (“MANUBANK”), a wholly-owned subsidiary of SMBC Americas Holdings, Inc. and Sumitomo Mitsui Banking Corporation (“SMBC”). The acquisition adds an established commercial banking franchise and seasoned professionals to Bank of Hope, diversifying its deposit segments and expanding its footprint and client base in the Greater Los Angeles market. The transaction also reinforces the Bank’s position as a premier financial partner to middle-market businesses and deepens its relationships across the Korean and Japanese business communities. “The completion of this transaction represents an important milestone in the continued evolution of Bank of Hope,” said Kevin S.
